Coram: Hon'Ble The Acting Chief Justice Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Navneet Kumar

--------
For the Appellant : Mr. Avishek Chandra, Advocate For the Respondents : Mr. Arpan Mishra,
Advocate Order No.4/ Dated 14th June, 2024

Before the writ Court, the BCCL took the following stand:
"10. That a land acquisition proceeding, being L.A. Case No.24 of 1981-82, was initiated for the purpose of acquisition of land for the Respondent-BCCL for its mining activity.
Apart from the acquisition proceeding, there was a land loser scheme of the Company under which the Respondent-BCCL had agreed to provide eighteen employments against acquisition of the land.

11. That the petitioner had obtained employment on the basis of the affidavit submitted by him i.e. Annexure-2 to the writ petition, wherein the petitioner had given the details of the land, disclosing the details of the land acquired under Land Loser Scheme and under the said Scheme, employment has been provided to the petitioner under the Respondent- BCCL.
12.

That a complaint petition was filed by one Ashok Kumar Mahato before the Managing Director, Bharat Coking Coal Limited, stating therein that on wrong affidavit and forged document, the petitioner had obtained employment under the Respondent-BCCL."
2.
The aforesaid stand taken by the BCCL prima facie seems to be vague and the only reason why an inquiry was conducted was a complaint made by Ashok Kumar Mahto.
3. This is not disclosed by the BCCL that the deceased employee or his ancestor(s) was not the person who received compensation for the subject land in LA Case No.24 of 1981-82.
